title: Stone Town City Tour & Spice Farm
bestTimeToGo: Year-round; clove harvest season (July–October) is especially aromatic
highlights: Guided walking tour of historic Stone Town — a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Explore the Old Fort, House of Wonders, and famous carved Zanzibari doors
Visit a traditional spice farm and smell, taste, and identify over 15 different spices
Learn the history of Zanzibar’s spice trade that shaped world commerce
Enjoy a traditional Swahili dinner prepared with freshly picked spices
Watch a local farmer scale a coconut palm with bare feet
Take home a small bag of mixed spices as a souvenir
includes: Traditional Swahili spice lunch or dinner
excludes: Drinks beyond water and coconut juice

itinerary.dayBody: Begin your morning with a guided walking tour of Stone Town, Zanzibar’s atmospheric UNESCO World Heritage heart. Wander through narrow alleyways lined with intricately carved wooden doors, visit the Old Fort and the former House of Wonders, browse the bustling Darajani Market, and hear the stories of sultans, slaves, and spice traders that shaped this extraordinary city. After exploring Stone Town, drive through the lush interior to Kizimbani, one of the island’s oldest spice-growing regions. A local farmer guides you through shaded groves where cloves, vanilla, cinnamon, black pepper, cardamom, nutmeg, and lemongrass flourish. Crush leaves between your fingers, learn to distinguish turmeric from ginger root, and watch skilled climbers harvest coconuts. The day culminates in a traditional Swahili dinner prepared with the very spices you’ve just discovered. Before heading back, you’ll receive a hand-wrapped spice gift bag to bring the aromas of Zanzibar home.

pickupInfo: Free hotel pickup and drop-off from Stone Town, Nungwi, Kendwa, and Paje. Pickup from other areas available on request.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour.

seo.title: Stone Town City Tour & Spice Farm | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Explore historic Stone Town and visit a working spice plantation on this full-day Zanzibar combo tour. Includes guided walking tour, spice tasting, traditional Swahili dinner, and hotel pickup.

content:
This full-day combo tour pairs two of Zanzibar’s most iconic experiences: the atmospheric streets of Stone Town and the fragrant spice farms that gave the island its famous nickname.

The morning begins in Stone Town — a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the most enchanting old quarters in the Indian Ocean. Your guide leads you through a labyrinth of narrow alleyways past magnificent carved doors, the Old Fort, and the bustling Darajani Market, sharing stories of the sultans, explorers, and traders who shaped this remarkable city over centuries.

In the afternoon, you head inland to the lush spice-growing heartland of Kizimbani. A local farmer — whose family has tended these groves for decades — will introduce you to over fifteen different spices and medicinal plants growing in their natural state. You’ll learn how a small dried bud becomes the clove that flavours kitchens worldwide, why Zanzibar vanilla is prized by pastry chefs, and how turmeric paste has been used in local beauty rituals for centuries. The experience goes beyond sight-seeing: you will touch, smell, and taste your way through the plantation before sitting down to a traditional Swahili dinner that brings everything together on the plate.
